coordinate_variables: bits 1..40 of x(U2+U3), then bits 0..40 of y(U2+U3)
holdout_pair_rule: uniform independent indices in the exact 1956-state domains 2 and 3; reject pair-index combinations already in the initial 8192 rows or already drawn in this holdout
stop_rule: Stop when coordinate quadratic rank reaches 3322, at 8192 new pair combinations, or at the declared resource cap. A remaining sample rank deficit is inconclusive.
claim_boundary: Tests whether the 124 coordinate-only quadratic dependencies in the first 8192 valid N41 two-pair sums persist on independently selected exact two-pair sums. Full rank on the combined sample proves the initial dependencies are sample-specific; a remaining deficit requires further support or symbolic analysis.
